# parse_lfs_pointer { #labdata.gitutil.parse_lfs_pointer }

```python
labdata.gitutil.parse_lfs_pointer(data)
```

Read a Git LFS pointer file.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**data**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bytes](`bytes`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Raw content of a blob, which may or may not be a pointer.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[Tuple](`typing.Tuple`)\[[str](`str`), [int](`int`)\]\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   ``(sha256_oid, real_size)`` if `data` is a pointer, else `None`.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
parse_lfs_pointer(read_blob(repo, blob_sha))
# ('9f2c...', 512189753)
```
